subject: Clarify APAC demo day-boundary / cutover policy
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Tan <kai@zephyr.ai>, Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kaito.co.jp>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — candidate slots

Hi Kai / Naoko —

Thanks again for the interest and for agreeing to a live walkthrough. Marcus and I proposed a few candidate windows this week but I noticed the calendar invite I just sent shows the meeting on the next calendar day for Naoko (JST) even though Kai sees it as the same day (SGT). I suspect the .ics defaulted to UTC and rolled across midnight.

Quick ask: can you confirm which local day/time is best for you? Below are two clean options with local times and UTC equivalents so we avoid any next-day confusion: 

- Option A — Tokyo / Singapore friendly (same local day): 2027-05-18 10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT (UTC 01:00)
- Option B — Sydney morning (next-day for Tokyo): 2027-05-18 11:30 AEST (UTC 01:30) — Note this will be 2027-05-18 09:30 JST (same calendar day) but 2027-05-18 10:30 SGT (same day).

I attached the .ics I created (redwood-demo-ics.ics) and a quick slot matrix (apac-demo-slots.xlsx). If helpful, we can lock Option A and Marcus will cover the APAC runbook.

Thanks — short reply with preferred option is fine.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-ics.ics (calendar invite), apac-demo-slots.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kai Tan <kai@zephyr.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kaito.co.jp>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 12:45:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — candidate slots

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks. I got the invite but my calendar shows it as 2027-05-17 17:00 SGT (previous evening) — which is clearly wrong. I think my calendar client interpreted the .ics timezone as UTC- but I typically see SGT offsets correctly.

For us in Singapore, Option A at 09:00 SGT on 2027-05-18 works best. Naoko, does that line up for you in Tokyo?

Kai
Senior Product Manager | Zephyr Systems

From: Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kaito.co.jp>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Kai Tan <kai@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 18:02:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — candidate slots

Hi all —

Option A (2027-05-18 10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT) is perfect for me. I confirmed with my admin; the odd invite time earlier was due to Outlook showing UTC for some imported .ics files.

Please send a confirmed invite in JST/SGT local time so it appears correctly in our calendars.

Regards,
Naoko
Head of Ops | Kaito Robotics

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Kai Tan <kai@zephyr.ai>, Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kaito.co.jp>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 19:15:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling demo — candidate slots

Thanks for confirming. Two quick internal notes (Ben and Jasmine) so we're aligned on how to prevent this: 

- When exporting .ics from Google Calendar the default TZ on my machine was set to UTC; I will explicitly set the DTSTART/TZID to Asia/Tokyo or Asia/Singapore before sending.
- We should pick a single timezone to present in the invite subject line (e.g., "10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT") and include the UTC offset in the body. That avoids client DST/display quirks.

Operationally: Jasmine, I'll own the APAC runbook for the demo and will join at 09:50 SGT. Ben, please have the Sydney fallback ready (AEST times) in case the customer needs a later window — I'm adding the demo-deck.pdf to the confirmed invite.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: demo-deck.pdf (pdf)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Tan <kai@zephyr.ai>, Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kaito.co.jp>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 18:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Confirmed: Demo — 2027-05-18 10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT

Hi Kai / Naoko —

Confirmed and thanks for the quick replies. I recreated the invite and attached the deck and a corrected .ics (redwood-demo-ics.ics) — it now explicitly sets TZID=Asia/Tokyo and TZID=Asia/Singapore for the times so it should render correctly across Outlook/Google/Apple clients. 

Calendar details (local times):
- Tokyo: 2027-05-18 10:00–10:45 JST
- Singapore: 2027-05-18 09:00–09:45 SGT
- Sydney (fallback): 2027-05-18 11:00–11:45 AEST

If anyone's calendar still shows something odd, reply-all with a screenshot and we'll fix immediately. We look forward to running through the demo and the sample SLOs for inference latency during live load.

Best,
Jasmine
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-ics.ics (calendar), demo-deck.pdf (pdf)
